exams: Grade 12 (or equivalent) with at least 60 percent and the right subjects: English, Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics for BSc Engineering, English, Physics, Chemistry and Biology for D Pharmacy (PTAP notice)
Equivalence certificate from the Inter Board Committee of Chairmen (IBCC) in Islamabad
Each university sets its own admission test or merit rule
abroad_add.intakes: Autumn session; the 2026/27 PTAP call closed on 10 July 2026 (Asar 26 2083)
abroad_add.work: Not clearly allowed: the public student visa material read does not grant general work rights, so assume none unless an official says otherwise.
abroad_add.stay_back: No post study stay route found. Foreign students on a proper student visa get a visa or extension for one year with one re-entry (fpcci.org.pk).
abroad_add.note: The practical route for a Nepali student is the Pakistan Technical Assistance Programme (PTAP): for 2026/27 the Ministry of Economic Affairs gave Nepal 14 seats, which Nepal fills from its own merit list. Without a PTAP seat, NUST charges international undergraduates USD 5,400 a year plus a USD 600 non refundable processing fee, a USD 250 refundable deposit and USD 120 for health (pakera.pk, maqsad.io, feestructure.pk; one guide prints USD 3,500 to 4,000 a semester, so read nust.edu.pk). The tuition range here starts at 0 because PTAP exemption from tuition and other dues follows each institution's policy. Living is cheap: a hostel student budgets PKR 18,000 to 31,000 a month at Lahore (campusaxis.pk) while a Numbeo style estimate for Islamabad is about PKR 64,640 (gyandhan.com); the range here is PKR 216,000 to about PKR 775,000 a year at PKR 1 about NPR 0.52. The student visa needs a no objection certificate from the education ministry and security clearance, and Pakistan Missions issue it only after the Ministry of Economic Affairs confirms admission (fpcci.org.pk, PTAP notice). Travel, boarding and lodging are paid by the student. NPR figures are rough.

exams: School certificate recognised by the Supreme Council of Universities
English proof for English medium private universities
Arabic for Arabic medium public faculties
abroad_add.intakes: Usually one intake in September or October (study-abroad.org)
abroad_add.work: Not checked yet: no Egyptian official page on student work rights was read.
abroad_add.note: Egypt has three very different price levels (study-abroad.org, 2026): public universities such as Cairo, Ain Shams, Alexandria, Mansoura and Assiut charge international students roughly EGP 5,000 to 15,000 a year (about NPR 15,000 to 45,000, medicine and dentistry often EGP 20,000 to 40,000 or more), English medium private universities (GUC, BUE, MUST, MIU) about USD 5,000 to 15,000, and the American University in Cairo about USD 25,000 to 40,000 (about NPR 36 to 58 lakh, the top of the range here). Al-Azhar is free for many Muslim international students and is run separately from the secular system. Cairo living is quoted at EGP 8,000 to 15,000 a month (about USD 165 to 310) but the pound has been volatile since the 2024 float. The route Nepal itself runs is postgraduate: the Medical Education Commission offers Government of Egypt scholarship seats for MD or MS (see the scholarship). A foreign medical degree counts for a licence in Nepal only if the Nepal Medical Council recognises that exact university, and you must pass the NMC licensing examination after returning, so ask the council before you pay a deposit. NPR figures are rough.

exams: School certificate recognised by the Qualifications Agency (the ENIC/NARIC centre in Belgrade, up to 60 days)
Faculty entrance exam; medicine tests biology and chemistry, Belgrade and Kragujevac add an interview
English (Kragujevac asks B2) for English taught programmes; a Serbian certificate for Serbian taught ones
abroad_add.intakes: October (academic year start); 2026/27 calls were published in spring 2026
abroad_add.work: Students need a National Employment Service work permit as well as temporary residence (expatsi.com); one agency page says up to 20 hours a week, which is the permit rule not a free right, so ask the university.
abroad_add.stay_back: Not an automatic route: after a degree you apply for work or another residence ground; study time counts at half towards three years needed for permanent residence (expatsi.com).
abroad_add.note: The University of Belgrade 2026/27 call lists Medicine in English at EUR 8,000 a year (EUR 48,000 over six years), Novi Sad medicine or dentistry in English EUR 7,000, Nis and Kragujevac medicine EUR 6,000, while most bachelor programmes cost a foreign student EUR 900 to 3,600 a year (studyu.org); another guide prints EUR 5,000 to 7,000 for medicine. Foreign students pay for the whole course and state funded places generally are not open to them. Monthly living is EUR 850 to 2,000 in Belgrade and EUR 750 to 1,450 in Novi Sad, Nis or Kragujevac (studyinserbia.rs) while the University of Belgrade itself estimates EUR 600 to 800; the range here runs EUR 600 to 2,000. Nepali students normally need a Type D visa for stays over 90 days, then temporary residence (government fee RSD 23,880, expatsi.com), health insurance and proof of funds. A foreign medical degree counts for a licence in Nepal only if the Nepal Medical Council recognises that exact university, and you must pass the NMC licensing examination after returning, so ask the council before you pay a deposit. NPR figures are rough.

exams: Qatar University undergraduate admission: school certificate, English proof, and college requirements
Branch campuses in Education City (Carnegie Mellon, Northwestern, Texas A&M, UCL) set their own entry rules
abroad_add.intakes: September; international undergraduate applications run about mid March to April (excelsiorscholarships.com)
abroad_add.work: Not checked yet: no Qatari official page on student work was read.
abroad_add.stay_back: Not checked yet. The residence permit is issued under university sponsorship within one month of arrival (qu.edu.qa).
abroad_add.note: Qatar University is the public flagship and the Nepali student pays international fees: QAR 1,700 a credit hour on its own international students page, with at least 11 credit hours a term, so a year of 24 to 30 credits is about QAR 40,800 to 51,000 (the range here, QAR 1 about NPR 39.7). Other guides print QAR 800 to 1,500 a credit hour, so confirm the table for your college. Education City branch campuses are far higher, QAR 100,000 to 250,000 a year in one guide. Doha living is about QAR 5,000 to 9,000 a month (brightkey.co); university dorm places are limited. No Nepal government scholarship for Qatar was found on the pages read.  NPR figures are rough.

exams: Arabic or French for most public programmes (English is growing; check the programme page)
School certificate recognised by the Moroccan ministry
Engineering schools and medicine run their own selection
abroad_add.intakes: September (the academic year runs September to June)
abroad_add.work: Not checked yet: no Moroccan official page on student work was read.
abroad_add.note: Public university tuition is the cheapest in this list but the three guides read disagree: MAD 1,000 to 5,000 a year (university.im), USD 500 to 2,000 (qogentglobal.com) and USD 200 to 500, with engineering schools at USD 1,000 to 4,000 (edunepal.com). Private universities are about MAD 40,000 to 120,000 and Al Akhawayn University about USD 8,000 to 12,000, the top of the range here. Monthly living is USD 300 to 700 depending on the guide and city (Rabat, Fez and Marrakech cheaper than Casablanca). Nepal's own route is the Government of Morocco civil engineering scholarship that the Ministry of Education passes on through the Nepal Embassy in New Delhi (5 seats for 2026/27, see the scholarship). A foreign engineering degree needs recognition checks with the Nepal Engineering Council before you rely on a licence. NPR figures are rough.

scholarships_add.name: Pakistan Technical Assistance Programme (PTAP) scholarship, BSc Engineering and D Pharmacy
scholarships_add.by: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Government of Pakistan, nominated through MoEST and the Medical Education Commission, Nepal
scholarships_add.covers: A seat in a Pakistani institution for 2026/27 with exemption from tuition and other dues as per each institution's policy; travel, boarding and lodging are paid by the student (PTAP notice). Programme running since 1976.
scholarships_add.who: Nepali citizens who passed Grade 12 or equivalent with at least 60 percent (English, Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics for engineering; English, Physics, Chemistry and Biology for D Pharmacy) and hold an IBCC equivalence certificate. 2026/27 seats for Nepal: Civil Engineering 2, Computer Engineering 2, Electrical Engineering 2, D Pharmacy 8 (14 in all). The Ministry of Education notice ties selection to the IOE Pulchowk entrance merit list.
scholarships_add.how: The Ministry of Education notice (July 2026) said to apply on its Google Form with transcript, citizenship and IOE score card, while Edusanjal quoting the PTAP notice says to apply on entrance.mec.gov.np under MECEE-BL 2026; the deadline was Asar 26 2083 (10 July 2026). Placement is by the Ministry of Economic Affairs, and the student visa is issued only after it confirms admission. Read the next call on moest.gov.np before applying.

scholarships_add.name: Government of Egypt scholarship for MD or MS (Radiology and Internal Medicine)
scholarships_add.by: Government of Egypt, offered through the Scholarship Section of the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology and the Medical Education Commission (MEC), Nepal
scholarships_add.covers: Postgraduate medical seats in Egypt for 2025/26. The pages read do not list the stipend, so check the Egyptian embassy or the ministry letter.
scholarships_add.who: Candidates on the MECEE-PG 2025 merit list. Egypt gave one seat each for MD or MS in Radiology and in Internal Medicine (Ministry letter ref 145 of 2082/01/26, Edusanjal).
scholarships_add.how: Apply online through your MEC profile (the 2025 window ran 27 to 30 May 2025); the final candidate is chosen in an Open House Matching Process where you must be present (31 May 2025). Calls repeat each year, so watch mec.gov.np.

scholarships_add.name: Government of Morocco scholarship in Civil Engineering (AMCI, 2026/27)
scholarships_add.by: Moroccan Agency for International Cooperation (AMCI), nominated through the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology, Nepal
scholarships_add.covers: Study in public Moroccan higher, technical and professional institutions; a living allowance of MAD 750 a month, about USD 80 (Collegenp quoting AMCI guidelines).
scholarships_add.who: Five seats for 2026/27: bachelor 3 (2 open and 1 for women) and master 2 (1 open and 1 for women), Civil Engineering only. Bachelor applicants must have passed Grade 12; master applicants need a bachelor degree and an entrance result or score card from the TU Institute of Engineering, Pulchowk (Nepal Register).
scholarships_add.how: The notice of 5 June 2026 asked for an online Google Form between 5 and 11 June 2026 within office hours; selection follows Nepal's scholarship nomination rules. Questions go to the Scholarship Section of the Ministry at Sanothimi, Bhaktapur. A new call is likely each year, so watch moest.gov.np.

scholarships_add.name: Future Global Leaders Scholarship (FGLS), Universitas Islam Indonesia
scholarships_add.by: Universitas Islam Indonesia (UII), forwarded to the Ministry of Education by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs after the Indonesian Embassy in Dhaka
scholarships_add.covers: Registration fee, tuition, Indonesian language and culture course, health insurance, living allowance, accommodation allowance, book allowance and thesis allowance (Ministry notice, 5 May 2026).
scholarships_add.who: Nepali citizens for undergraduate, master and doctoral programmes in many majors at UII. You need an Indonesian or English language certificate, and academic certificates and transcripts certified by the Ministry of Education and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, in English. No Indonesian Embassy recommendation letter is needed.
scholarships_add.how: Apply on the UII admission portal. Academic year 2026: Intake 1 ran 1 February to 30 April 2026 (undergraduate and postgraduate; results 29 May), Intake 2 ran 1 October to 30 November 2026 for postgraduate only (interviews 7 to 11 December, results 18 December). Shortlisted candidates go through document selection and an interview. UII International Affairs: io@uii.ac.id.

scholarships_add.name: United International University (Dhaka) BSc Data Science tuition waiver, 2 seats
scholarships_add.by: United International University (UIU), Bangladesh, nominated through the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology, Nepal (Rule 10(a) of the Scholarship Rules, 2060)
scholarships_add.covers: 100 percent tuition fee waiver for the BSc in Data Science (Collegenp, 2 May 2026). Other costs are not listed.
scholarships_add.who: Two seats, distributed inclusively: one open and one for women. You must have passed Grade 12 and hold an entrance result or score card for the undergraduate Data Science programme run by the School of Mathematical Sciences, Institute of Science and Technology, Tribhuvan University. Documents: Grade 10 and Grade 12 certificates and marksheets, passport information page and a passport size photo.
scholarships_add.how: The 2083 call opened on Baisakh 17 and closed on Baisakh 25 2083 (8 May 2026) on a Google Form published by the Ministry. Contact the Scholarship Section at Sanothimi, Bhaktapur. Expect a similar call after the next TU Data Science entrance.

scholarships_add.name: Tianjin University scholarship for Master and PhD (2026/27, via MoEST)
scholarships_add.by: Tianjin University, China, nominated through the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology, Nepal
scholarships_add.covers: Not listed on the notice pages read; the full notice is the PDF on the Ministry page.
scholarships_add.who: Eligible Nepali students for postgraduate and doctoral study in the subjects listed on the Ministry notice (the listing is in the PDF, not in the pages read).
scholarships_add.how: By a decision of 2082/09/16 the Ministry asked for applications on paper at its Scholarship Section, Sanothimi, Bhaktapur, within office hours until Poush 29 2082 (mid January 2026). Watch the Ministry for the 2027/28 call.

scholarship_note_add.s-mgss: One third party page (smartacademyhq.com) prints 29 November 2026 as the deadline, while the Embassy notice quoted by educatenepal.com and Edusanjal says the portal closed at 00.00 on 16 November 2026, so trust the Embassy dates.

faq_add.q: Is there a free scholarship to study engineering or pharmacy in Pakistan?
faq_add.a: Yes, through the Pakistan Technical Assistance Programme (PTAP), running since 1976. For 2026/27 Pakistan gave Nepal 14 seats: Civil, Computer and Electrical Engineering 2 each and D Pharmacy 8 (Edusanjal, Nepal Diplomat, 9 July 2026). You need Grade 12 with at least 60 percent in the right subjects and an IBCC equivalence certificate. The Ministry of Education tied selection to the IOE Pulchowk entrance merit list, while Edusanjal says to apply under MECEE-BL 2026 on entrance.mec.gov.np, so read the current call. Tuition and other dues are waived as per each institution's policy; travel, boarding and lodging are yours. The 2026 deadline was 10 July.

faq_add.q: Can I study medicine in Serbia in English and what will it cost?
faq_add.a: Yes at the public universities of Belgrade, Novi Sad, Nis and Kragujevac. The 2026/27 figures read on studyu.org are EUR 8,000 a year in Belgrade, EUR 7,000 in Novi Sad and EUR 6,000 in Nis and Kragujevac, so six years cost about EUR 36,000 to 48,000 (roughly NPR 63 lakh to 84 lakh at EUR 1 about NPR 175). Entry is a biology and chemistry test, and Belgrade and Kragujevac add an interview. Your school certificate must be recognised by the Qualifications Agency in Belgrade first (up to 60 days). A different guide prints EUR 5,000 to 7,000, so read the faculty's own call. Before paying, ask the Nepal Medical Council whether it recognises the exact university, because you must pass its licensing examination after returning.

faq_add.q: Which Egypt options does Nepal itself offer?
faq_add.a: The Medical Education Commission passes on Government of Egypt seats for postgraduate medicine. For 2025/26 Egypt allotted one seat each for MD or MS in Radiology and Internal Medicine (Ministry letter ref 145 of 2082/01/26, Edusanjal). You had to be on the MECEE-PG 2025 merit list, apply through your MEC profile between 27 and 30 May 2025 and attend an Open House Matching Process on 31 May. Calls repeat yearly, so watch mec.gov.np. For a self funded bachelor, public universities charge international students roughly EGP 5,000 to 15,000 a year, while the American University in Cairo is about USD 25,000 to 40,000 (study-abroad.org).

faq_add.q: What does Qatar University charge a Nepali student?
faq_add.a: Qatar University's international students page lists QAR 1,700 a credit hour (about USD 466) with a minimum of 11 credit hours a term, so a year of 24 to 30 credits is about QAR 40,800 to 51,000, roughly NPR 16 to 20 lakh at QAR 1 about NPR 39.7. Other guides print lower rates (QAR 800 to 1,500), so confirm the table for your college. The residence permit is issued under university sponsorship within one month of arrival. Doha living is about QAR 5,000 to 9,000 a month (brightkey.co). No Nepal government scholarship for Qatar was found.

faq_add.q: Can I work part time as a student in Serbia or Pakistan?
faq_add.a: Serbia: you need temporary residence and a separate work permit from the National Employment Service even for part time work (expatsi.com); one agency page says 20 hours a week, which is the permit rule and not a free right. Pakistan: the public student visa material read does not clearly grant work rights, so assume none. Foreign students on a proper student visa get a one year visa or extension with one re-entry (fpcci.org.pk). For work friendly destinations compare the Pathways country pages first.

faq_add.q: Which scholarships did the Ministry of Education pass on to Nepali students in 2026?
faq_add.a: Notices published in 2026 and read on Nepal Register and Collegenp: Tianjin University for Master and PhD (applications until Poush 29 2082, mid January 2026), United International University Dhaka BSc Data Science with 2 tuition free seats (closed 8 May 2026, needs the TU Data Science entrance score card), UII Indonesia Future Global Leaders Scholarship (Intake 1 closed 30 April, postgraduate Intake 2 closed 30 November 2026), Morocco civil engineering with 5 seats (closed 11 June 2026), Pakistan PTAP with 14 seats (closed 10 July 2026) and Egypt MD or MS seats through MEC. Most of these are short windows on a Google Form, so follow moest.gov.np and your campus notice board instead of waiting for an agent.

faq_add.q: What does the Morocco civil engineering scholarship pay?
faq_add.a: The Moroccan Agency for International Cooperation (AMCI) guidelines, as quoted by Collegenp on 6 June 2026, give a living allowance of MAD 750 a month, about USD 80, for study in public Moroccan institutions. There were five seats for 2026/27: three at bachelor (two open, one for women) and two at master (one open, one for women). Bachelor applicants needed Grade 12, master applicants a bachelor degree and a TU IOE Pulchowk entrance score card (Nepal Register). The window ran 5 to 11 June 2026.

faq_add.q: How much does it cost to study in Morocco?
faq_add.a: The guides read disagree. One prints MAD 1,000 to 5,000 a year at public universities (university.im), another USD 500 to 2,000 (qogentglobal.com) and a third USD 200 to 500 with engineering schools at USD 1,000 to 4,000 (edunepal.com). Private universities are about MAD 40,000 to 120,000 and Al Akhawayn about USD 8,000 to 12,000. Living is USD 300 to 700 a month depending on the guide and city. Read the university's own fee page and ask the Nepal Engineering Council or Nepal Medical Council about recognition before you pay.
